title: R16 v3: orchestrator/stale.py — complete stale-work evidence with a git adapter for gitutil, freshness bound to the task worktree, and pinned risk reasons (AP P12)
spec:
Why: daemon.stale_check (orchestrator/daemon.py:1050-1070) compares only moved paths against scope plus changed files and grades none/low/high; brief P7 also requires interface, relevant-test, dependency, graph-relationship and overlapping-merge signals with base, goal head, relevant paths, risk, action and conflict outcome. v3 after spec reviews T-0576 and T-0595.
What: new pure module orchestrator/stale.py; daemon delegation is a later task; today's stale_check keys stay a subset. Tests: this repo runs unittest; every acceptance test id is a `def test_name(self)` method inside a unittest.TestCase subclass in that file; no pytest fixtures.
- Git: the injectable callable has the shape git(*args, cwd) -> CompletedProcess (default: subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True)). gitutil.moved_paths and gitutil.changed_paths take git(cwd, *args); stale.py wraps with the named adapter _gitutil_git(git) -> lambda cwd, *args: git(*args, cwd=cwd) and passes it as their git= parameter. interference.graph_fresh_for(files, graph, git=_fresh_git) receives _fresh_git = lambda worktree, *args: git(*args, cwd=task['worktree']) so freshness is diffed on the task branch, not ROOT.
- load_links(root=ROOT) -> {"files": {node_id: source_file}, "links": [{"source", "target", "relation"}]} from graphify-out/graph.json (nodes[].id/source_file, links[].source/target/relation); None when absent or malformed.
- evidence(task, *, goal_ref=None, graph_links=None, graph=None, tasks=None, git=None) -> {"base": task_ref, "goal_head", "moved_count", "stale_paths", "signals": {"scoped_files_changed", "changed_files_moved", "tests_changed", "interface_changed": [{"symbol", "file", "consumer"}], "graph_relationships": [{"source_file", "target_file"}], "dependency_changed": [ids], "overlapping_merge": [ids]}, "risk", "risk_reasons", "graph"}. Worktree only from task['worktree']; goal_ref default goal/<parent> or main.
  Signals: moved = gitutil.moved_paths(task_ref, goal_ref, cwd=task['worktree'], git=adapter); changed = gitutil.changed_paths(task, git=adapter); scoped_files_changed = moved matching scope patterns (fnmatch); changed_files_moved = moved ∩ changed; tests_changed = moved paths equal to tests/test_<stem>.py for stems of changed or scoped orchestrator/*.py; interface_changed (needs graph_links and graph): nodes whose source_file is a moved file with a link of any relation to a node whose source_file is a changed or scoped task file, only when graph_fresh_for(moved ∪ task files, graph, git=_fresh_git) is True; graph_relationships = distinct (moved file, task file) pairs behind those links; dependency_changed = depends_on ids whose task record sha is not an ancestor of task_ref (git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> <task_ref>, rc 1 = not ancestor); overlapping_merge = execute tasks in `tasks` with merged_into == goal_ref whose scope literals or task.get('changed_files', []) intersect the task's changed or scope paths and whose sha is not an ancestor of task_ref (changed_files optional; a later merge task populates it).
  graph field: 'absent' when graph_links or graph is None; 'stale' when graph_fresh_for is not True; 'skipped' when the graph is present and fresh but no moved path or task path appears as any node's source_file (nothing to compare); 'used' otherwise.
  Risk and pinned reasons (risk_reasons lists every fired signal in this order): high with any of changed_files_moved, interface_changed, dependency_changed; medium with any of tests_changed, graph_relationships, overlapping_merge; low with scoped_files_changed only; none with []; unknown with ['git_failed'] when gitutil.GitError or the git callable raises.
- row(task, evidence, action, conflict=None) -> dict for schedlog.append('stale', ...) with task, goal_id, base, goal_head, changed_relevant_paths, risk, risk_reasons, action (recorded|rebased|rebase_conflict|revalidated), conflict paths. Never mutates git; never discards work.
acceptance: tests/test_stale.py::test_interface_change_in_moved_file_consumed_by_task_is_high_risk — graph_links with a link from a node in a moved file to a node in the task's changed file, fresh graph, yields interface_changed non-empty, risk high, risk_reasons containing interface_changed and graph used
tests/test_stale.py::test_relevant_test_change_is_medium_risk — tests/test_foo.py moved while the task changed orchestrator/foo.py yields tests_changed, risk medium, risk_reasons ['tests_changed']

tests/test_stale.py::test_dependency_merged_after_branch_point_is_high_risk — a depends_on task whose sha is not an ancestor (git callable answers merge-base --is-ancestor with rc 1) yields dependency_changed and risk high

tests/test_stale.py::test_overlapping_earlier_merge_uses_scope_literals_and_optional_changed_files — a merged execute task matching by scope literal and one matching only through changed_files both appear in overlapping_merge; risk medium
tests/test_stale.py::test_git_adapter_and_freshness_use_task_worktree — every recorded git call carries cwd equal to task['worktree'], including the diff graph_fresh_for issues

tests/test_stale.py::test_absent_stale_skipped_graph_and_git_failure — graph_links None yields graph absent with deterministic signals intact; a stale graph yields graph stale and no interface signal; a fresh graph with no matching files yields graph skipped; a git callable raising GitError yields risk unknown and risk_reasons ['git_failed']; row() carries base, goal_head, changed_relevant_paths, risk, risk_reasons, action

constraints.interface_contract: load_links(root=ROOT) -> {files, links[{source,target,relation}]}|None; evidence(task, *, goal_ref=None, graph_links=None, graph=None, tasks=None, git=None) -> dict with keys base, goal_head, moved_count, stale_paths, signals{...}, risk, risk_reasons, graph; row(task, evidence, action, conflict=None); git callable git(*args, cwd) -> CompletedProcess adapted via _gitutil_git for gitutil; worktree only from task['worktree']; must not import daemon
